items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: オハイオ州コロンバスの不動産事業者Link Real Estate Group, LLCに対し、Ohio Tax Credit Authorityが雇用創出税額控除(JCTC)を承認。7年間1.370%の税額控除で、新規雇用40人・年間給与$2.8Mの創出が条件。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.370% for 7 years on 2022-08-29 for a project in the City of Columbus , Franklin County. Commitment: create 40 full-time equivalent employees generating $2,800,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.
